title: Charge Transport in Magnetized Holographic $\mathcal{M}$-QGP
summary: We investigate DC transport in a top-down construction of thermal QGP-like theories using a holographic $\mathcal{M}$-theoretic background, incorporating quartic curvature corrections. The DC and Hall conductivities are computed from the Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) action of the corresponding type-IIA probe $D6$ flavor branes via the reality condition method proposed in arXiv:0708.1994, arXiv:0705.3870.
